title: China adds ten US companies, including MP Materials and Teal Drones, to export controls and bars government purchases from 46 US companies, including Anduril (Wataru Suzuki/Nikkei Asia)
summary: Wataru Suzuki / Nikkei Asia: China adds ten US companies, including MP Materials and Teal Drones, to export controls and bars government purchases from 46 US companies, including Anduril — BEIJING — China on Monday announced new restrictions on exports and government procurement targeting dozens of American companies …
